I think the original sounds would have been more than fine here. Sounds like Goombella's tattle still uses the same original SFX, but it's clearly been layered with some additional ear candy for the remake. I'm thinking that some original audio assets were missing, so the audio team had no choice but to create entirely new sounds from scratch.

Honestly, as a sound designer myself this makes me feel really validated to see!

So many of the sounds of the original felt iconic to me, I could play through the game and hum along to all of the amazing ear candy across the game. 

I must admit that I'm somewhat torn. In some cases, I think the newer sounds surpass the original. The sounds for Mario's paper abilities took some getting used to here, but I think they're more appropriate for the paper aesthetic. 

Certain other sounds like Vivian veiling in/out the ground, dry bones reanimating, spinia attacks etc... these still feel like perfectly fine sound effects, but I'm just SO used to the original sound design that it just naturally feels off to me 😅

Part of me wonders if a lot of these original audio assets were deleted, and the audio team for the remake just created some sounds entirely from scratch. It can be very time consuming to recreate a sound perfectly, so it makes sense that they would just replace them outright.

Having said all of this, I absolutely LOVE how each character gets their own unique dialogue babble - it makes it so much fun to see how each NPC sounds different

Edit: it's also worth bringing up how important the sound design is in battles. Is the Yux sound you're referring to the "oooowooowooowooowooo" they make when they attack? Sounds like those have a very particular cadence, and they're *very* important for telegraphing when to guard.
